    • parseYamlConfig

      protected void parseYamlConfig(String configPath)
      Parses a YAML configuration file to build the image source chain. The first source in the list must be a base ImageSource with a path. Subsequent sources must be ManipulatorImageSources.

      Example YAML format: 

      sources:
  - type: default
    path: /path/to/base/image.jpg
  - type: filter
    options:
      type: sepia
      Parameters:
      configPath - The path to the YAML configuration file.
